gen-gf-baumans-gf-cardo: Baumans draws a wide-open crescent c in a line as uniform as bent wire. Cardo follows in a text serif, its fuller stems and slimmer links giving the page a soft, literary cadence beneath that rigid heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-graduate: Graduate takes its time, with generous space between each serif letter. Baumans is best at stamping a bold, wire-drawn presence, while Graduate does its finest work in low-contrast lines where capitals and lowercase sit nearly level.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mate: Mate reads soft and cupped, its round letters never clenched. Mate's gentle step from heavy to light strokes carries a long page along smoothly, while Baumans keeps its marker-plain heading firmly above.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-spectral-sc: Wire-drawn, wide-mouthed, unmistakably loud. Baumans traces every outline at one width you could follow with a finger, and Spectral SC settles beneath it in a classic serif with sturdy hairlines and sensible thick-thin shifts.
gen-gf-baumans-plus-jakarta-sans: Round, wiry and a bit bold, Baumans leads with a crescent-wrench c. And Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a plain sans of monoline curves with open endings, so a long passage moves along crisp and uncluttered.
gen-gf-baumans-sora: Sora reads crisp and geometric, with its c and s kept widely parted and no swelling at the curves. Baumans is best at commanding attention with its uniform, wrench-open lettering, and Sora is best at quietly carrying the details.
gen-gf-bellota-author: Author brings a refined, dignified voice, with just a slight swell on its bowls. Author handles the steady reading in a classic serif, while Bellota is best at making a flat, stylus-width statement with far-hanging s ends.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-karma: Bellota looks like thin steel rod bent into letters, its s ends hanging far from the spine. But Karma is the one built for reading, a serif whose horizontals run slightly slimmer than its verticals and whose modulation never snags the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-roundo: Distinctive, and a little commanding too, thanks to Bellota's far-reaching s. Roundo's sans keeps every small counter unclogged and its n tidy, which makes the pairing's strongest quality a crisp, geometric clarity.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-rowan: Rowan is friendly and literary, with generous openings in every curve. Bellota holds its heading line flat and unmodulated, so Rowan's classic serif, with a mild thick-and-thin rhythm, supplies the movement underneath.
